_schema.description: article id -> what was published for it. Step 2 reads this to decide POST (new) or PUT (update), which is what makes the publish idempotent. One entry per article. Never delete an entry; a removed article gets "status": "retired".

entry.intercom_id: string - Intercom article id, the key for idempotent re-publish
entry.brief: string - path to the approved brief
entry.spec: string - path to the Playwright spec that captured it
entry.commit_sha: string - the commit the screenshot URLs are pinned to
entry.screenshots: string[] - screenshot paths, in article order, with content hashes
